column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., researcher, data analyst, admin). always exactly one of 'researcher', 'data analyst', 'admin'. may be NULL.
Department of the user. may be NULL.
Position of the user. may be NULL.
Access level of the user (e.g., read, write, admin). always exactly one of 'read', 'write', 'admin'. may be NULL.
